verified_good_products.title: Portable Container Home
verified_good_products.description:
Our Portable Shipping Container Home are tailor made as per your requirement. These are available in different models for versatile needs, these do not require heavy lifting equipment for transportation and can be shifted with hydras. Lighting, air-conditioning, furniture, bath fittings, and other attachments can be easily accommodated. In addition, inter-connected rooms can also be created by joining 2 or more cabins.


We call them “residential buildings”, but you can just call it home! We have a great range of modular factory-built homes, all specially designed for Indian conditions and built with top-quality materials and construction.


Portable homes are growing in popularity, especially here in India. People love them for a lot of different reasons. They’re affordable, flexible, energy-efficient, and can be ready in a lot less time than a traditional building project. Our homes are beautifully designed and built with expert craftsmanship and top-quality materials.


Features:

  • All-in-one Site office with kitchenette
  • Toilet block
  • Recommended for small construction sites, volume builders and civil projects
  • The wide range of exterior & interior colors


Price Range: Rs. 1200-1300/Square Feet

image_pattern_summary: Verified good container home images consistently show the full exterior of the corrugated steel container unit from a three-quarter or straight-on angle, with doors and windows clearly visible. Units are photographed in real-world outdoor settings — construction yards, gardens, or open sites — on ground or foundation level. Multi-storey stacked configurations and single-unit homes both follow the same exterior-focused, full-structure framing convention.

reason: Container homes are physical structures whose quality and configuration are communicated entirely through visual appearance — exterior finish, window/door placement, and structural form.
No meaningful product specification text is printed on the container walls; OCR would extract only incidental brand plaques or date stamps.
Buyers assess container homes by seeing the structure itself — material quality, size impression, and finish level — not by reading text from the image.
